step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an audio ingestion and speech analytics pipeline. Audio files land in an initial S3 bucket, triggering AWS Step Functions. Step Functions orchestrates speech-to-text conversion via Amazon Transcribe, followed by sentiment analysis in Amazon Comprehend. Processed speech data and enrichment results are saved into an intermediary S3 bucket acting as a data lake, which then feeds into Elasticsearch (OpenSearch) for searching by internal users via a UI screen.
